scripts.check: pnpm core:wasm && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && tsc -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p embed/tsconfig.json
scripts.golden:update: pnpm core:wasm && UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 vitest run src/lib/db/golden.test.ts
scripts.core:wasm: cargo build -p sapling-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/lib/db/wasm --out-name sapling_core target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sapling_wasm.wasm
scripts.desktop:check: cargo clippy -p sapling-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p sapling-desktop
scripts.desktop:android: cd crates/sapling-desktop && tauri android build --ci --apk --target aarch64 --config '{"build":{"beforeBuildCommand":""}}'
